LanguageData.HardyPlants_TemperaturesDesc: Below the minimum a plant stops growing. A hardy plant gets these values only where they are better than its own.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_FrostDesc: Vanilla plants go leafless 10–18 °C below their minimum growth temperature. Hardy plants survive this much more.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GroupCustom: My own selection (list on the right)
LanguageData.HardyPlants_FasterGrowthDesc: Crops, trees and wild plants – each with its own speed. Works at once for every plant on the map, also for plants that appear later. No restart. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GrowAllDayDesc: Plants do not rest at night, and plants under the open sky also grow in the dark. Plants under a roof still need lamps. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_CropDays: Set how long crops take to grow
LanguageData.HardyPlants_TreeDays: Set how long trees take to grow
LanguageData.HardyPlants_DaysDesc: Days at 100 % growth rate. Plants rest at night (unless 24/7 is on) and grow slower in poor light, soil or temperature, so in a real game it takes longer. Applied when this window is closed – no restart. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_YieldDesc: How much crops and wild plants give when harvested and how much wood a tree gives. Works at once. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_RegrowDesc: How fast wild plants and trees come back on the map after cutting, grazing or fire. Plant density still follows the biome. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_IgnoreSoil: Poor soil does not slow growth
LanguageData.HardyPlants_IgnoreSoilDesc: On sand, gravel and poor soil plants grow at full speed. Rich soil still helps. Where nothing grows, nothing changes. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_NoBlightDesc: The blight event no longer happens and blight does not spread. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GrowthNote: Speed, yield, regrowth, soil, blight and 24/7 work at once, grow times after closing this window.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_PresetVanilla_Card: Growth and yield like the base game.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_ProfRec_Card: Faster growth, bigger harvests, no blight, greenhouses and wild plants under snow. Still fair.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_PresetLush_Card: Plants everywhere, growing fast day and night, in any season and unharmed by events.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_ProfileHint: Change anything under Growth or Yield and the profile switches to Custom. Orange CHANGED = differs from recommended, click it to restore.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_AnySeason: Sow and grow in any season
LanguageData.HardyPlants_AnySeasonDesc: Crops can be sown and grow whenever the temperature lets them – no "growing season" limit. Plants still need warmth to grow fast.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GreenhouseDesc: Plants under a built roof in a closed room grow at full speed whatever the temperature (from −10 °C up), in any season, and never freeze. Use lamps for light.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_FruitRepeatDesc: Harvesting fruit from a tree (from mods) does not cut it down – it grows the fruit again. Cutting it for wood still works.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_WildDensityDesc: More (or fewer) wild plants and trees on the map than the biome normally has.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_SnowGrowth: Wild plants grow back under snow
LanguageData.HardyPlants_SnowGrowthDesc: Normally nothing new sprouts on snow-covered ground all winter. With this on, wild plants and trees come back under snow where it is warm enough.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_FewerFiresDesc: Grass, bushes and trees catch fire about three times less easily, so a fire does not eat the whole forest.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_OverviewNoGame: Load a game to see what grows on your map.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_OverviewNums: Tried to grow {0} wild plants, {1} grew ({2} trees).
LanguageData.HardyPlants_OverviewNoneSnow: Nothing grows – probably snow. Turn on "Wild plants grow back under snow".
LanguageData.HardyPlants_OverviewNoneCold: Nothing grows – it is too cold, or the ground is full. Try a lower "Under snow from" temperature.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_ImmuneEventsDesc: Drought (also dry spells from mods), noxious haze, toxic fallout and pollution no longer slow plants down or make them leafless. Cold and heat still count.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GrowMapDesc: Shows on the map where {0} grows: green – well, yellow – slower, red – not at all. Hover a cell for the reason. Right click: show another plant.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GrowMapBanner: Where {0} grows – green: well, yellow: slower, red: no. Hover a cell for the reason.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GM_DarkSlow: Grows slower: not enough light under the roof – add a sun lamp.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GM_TooCold: Too cold now: {0}, it grows between {1}.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GM_TooHot: Too hot now: {0}, it grows between {1}.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GM_NoSoil: Does not grow here: the ground is too poor ({0}, needs {1}).
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GM_TooDark: Too dark under the roof – it needs a lamp.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GM_OnlyGrower: Only in hydroponics or a planter – not in the ground here.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_AutoGuess: Guess for plants from other mods
LanguageData.HardyPlants_AutoGuessDesc: Plants from other mods that no biome lists, or that give wood without being marked as trees, are sorted by their own values (kind, cold-hardiness). Marked "auto" in the list.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_AutoTip: From {0}. Evergrowth sees it as: {1}, grows from {2}, {3} days to grow.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_AutoKindGuessed: Treated as {0}: it gives wood, but its mod did not mark it as a tree.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_AutoAddedWild: No biome lists it – added to the wild plants group.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_AutoAddedCold: No biome lists it – added to the wild plants group and, as it grows in the cold, to the cold biomes group.
